instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Show me one tool's whole row, so I can see how it is written and how to call it", and give it tool_id (The id of the tool to describe).
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:describe-a-tool and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give the tool's id and the rows the Workshop answered (tools:list) as shared.
4. It reads no store and writes nothing: your AI reads your saved row of the tool (record type tool) and gives it as saved.
